opening.argument: The video presents Bitconnect as a direct opportunity to obtain unusually high recurring returns, stating that viewers “can earn 10 to 30 % monthly” and displaying the speaker’s claimed daily earnings of “one percent one and half percent Two percent I earn.” This is not framed as a warning, investigation, or detached report. The video also shows an account interface with lending and wallet options, demonstrating a path to participate and invest. That participation message is reinforced by the description’s Bitconnect referral link, providing viewers with a direct route to the promoted opportunity. Taken together, the return claims, personal earnings display, investment interface, and referral link encourage viewers to join rather than merely describe the offer.
